page.overview:
Who is Mr. Gutierrez?

Mr. Gutierrez is the father of Sammy Gutierrez. He and his family provided the meat for the carnivores of Jurassic World. When Mantah Corp requested to send his daughter to spy and steal dinosaur DNA for them, Mr. Gutierrez and his wife refused to use their daughter that way, but Sammy agreed to prevent their family from losing the ranch. They didn't know what she did until she went to Isla Nublar.

After the Jurassic World incident, Mr. Gutierrez and his family now provide meat for Mantah Corp Island, although they do not know where they are taking them. At the end Mr. Gutierrez is seen reuniting with his daughter and was surprised but happy to see that she and Yasmina are a couple. Two years later, Sammy and her family continue to provide the meat, for Mantah Corp's Island now as the "Secret Island".

Six years after the Jurassic World Incident in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory Sammy mentions that her family does not speak with her which includes Mr. Gutierrez. Lewis Dodgson later reveals that he made a deal with Gutierrez ranch and Sammy explains to Kenji that after the fallout from Masrani and Mantah Corp, the money Dodgson offered was too good for her parents to pass up. As Sammy knew that Biosyn wasn't trustworthy, she and her parents fought about it, culminating in Sammy's family not talking to her.

Following the Biosyn Incident, Sammy begins to reconcile with her parents, although things are still hard between them.
